name: auth
description: Authentik forward-auth (headers believed only from the trusted proxy) -> users + roles, publicRoute / requireAuth / requireRole with a rule that every route declares one, service tokens (hash only, expiry, revoke), explicit dev mode. UI: the layer's useAuth reads GET /api/v1/me

env.description: Shared secret the reverse proxy adds as `x-auth-proxy-secret` (>= 16 chars). Forward-auth headers are believed only with it and/or AUTH_TRUSTED_PROXIES
Addresses / CIDR ranges of the reverse proxy (the TCP peer), comma-separated
1 = every request is the fixed dev user with all roles. Development only: the API refuses to start with it when NODE_ENV=production

next: {{kit.apiDir}}: local development — set AUTH_DEV_MODE=1 in .env (never in production); production — see "Auth" in .memory/docs/guides/usage.md for what the reverse proxy and the identity provider must be given
